title: Pro Shop Store Credit: redemption channels, limits and purchase terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's redemption facet across every tier: which channels a member may redeem through, the tier's daily redemption ceiling, whether pro-shop purchases carry a price-match guarantee, whether this credit may be combined with a pro-shop sale discount on the same purchase, which purchase-item categories the credit may not be redeemed against, and the discount off pro-shop purchases paid with this credit.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Redemption channels allowed | Daily redemption ceiling | Price-match guarantee | May combine with a sale discount | Excluded purchase-item categories | Discount off purchases paid with this credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | front desk, app | 100.00 USD | No | Yes | gift cards | 0 percent |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | front desk, app, web | 150.00 USD | No | Yes | gift cards | 0 percent |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | front desk, app, web, phone | 250.00 USD | Yes | Yes | gift cards | 5 percent |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | front desk, app, web, phone | 500.00 USD | Yes | Yes | none | 10 percent |
| Auto-Reload Standard | front desk, app, web | 150.00 USD | No | Yes | gift cards | 0 percent |
| Auto-Reload Premium | front desk, app, web, phone | 300.00 USD | Yes | Yes | none | 5 percent |

## Points of reference
- The redemption channels allowed list which service channels will accept a redemption of that tier's credit; a channel not listed for a tier does not accept a redemption of that tier's credit.
- The daily redemption ceiling stated here is the tier's own standing figure; a separate document covers how the current extended handling basis measures and enforces that ceiling against a member's redemption activity.
- The excluded purchase-item categories name the categories of pro-shop item that this tier's credit may never be redeemed against, regardless of the amount available.
- The discount off purchases paid with this credit is a price reduction on pro-shop items bought using the credit, distinct from the redemption amount itself.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tiers currently exclude no purchase-item category?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier and Auto-Reload Premium.
**Which tier offers the widest set of redemption channels together with the lowest daily ceiling among those with the widest set?** The Value Credit $250 Tier, Auto-Reload Premium, and the VIP Credit $500 Tier all list the same four channels; among these, the Value Credit $250 Tier carries the lowest daily ceiling, at 250.00 USD.
